about: The search benchmark: simple questions whose answers are known, each tailored to a kind of source, run end to end with the live models and the live web. A change to search or a skill is judged by these numbers, not by reading one run. Each expected item is found when one of its patterns appears in an established claim's quote (the source's own words), so a run is scored on evidence, not on what the writer says. 'partial' marks a list whose full answer is not known: what is listed must be found, more is welcome.
